C1.worst_defect: The first sentence a shop owner reads explains the product with developer jargon: "an open-source till for Vendure, the open-source headless commerce framework"; and on the phone the top bar shows only "Docs" and "Live demo", so the owner's own page "At the till" is hidden behind the chevron.

C2.worst_defect: The comparison table row "Refund a sale at the till: Yes" for the live demo sits beside "No, not on plugin 0.3.0" for your own store, so the demo shows staff a refund flow they will not have in the shop.
C2.where: home.desktop.02 / home.phone.04 ("Live demo or your own store" table)

C3.worst_defect: The refund path for a real store ends in developer work the owner cannot do: "The refund stays Pending until an administrator settles it with two Admin API calls; see Plugin setup", with no plain statement of who in a two-person shop does that or when.
C3.where: home.phone.04 / at-the-till (Refund a sale) / plugin-setup (Settle a Dashboard refund)

C4.worst_defect: The cashier sheet screenshot mixes clock formats in one picture, "Register · open since 22:07" and "Last synced 10:07 PM"; troubleshooting and changelog are written for developers (errorCode, needs_admin GraphQL, ADR links), not for staff at the counter.

C5.worst_defect: The cashier sheet and closure screen images sit small inside wide, mostly empty frames on desktop, leaving large blank gaps in the At the till page.

C6.worst_defect: The phone header on home collapses Quick start and At the till behind a chevron next to "Docs" and "Live demo", and At the till runs to nine phone slices with no back-to-top, so finding "Count the drawer and close the day" between customers takes the section dropdown or a long scroll.

C7.worst_defect: Minor: the quick-start page's mobile LCP is 2.6 s (Lighthouse 97) and the 404 page carries no JSON-LD; everything else (titles, descriptions, og card, llms.txt, sitemap, search API for "offline") is in place.

overall_worst.defect: On plugin 0.3.0 a customer refund cannot be done at the till: the owner must refund in the Vendure Dashboard, where "The refund stays Pending until an administrator settles it with two Admin API calls", then record a Pay out and refund the card on the terminal; the site never says in plain words who in a small shop does the API step, while the demo shows refunds at the till as "Yes".
overall_worst.where: home.phone.04 / home.desktop.02 (table row "Refund a sale at the till"); at-the-till (Refund a sale)
overall_worst.fix: In the refund row and the At the till refund section, add one sentence saying the settle step is a one-time job for your developer (or link a ready script), and link straight to Plugin setup's "Settle a Dashboard refund" anchor instead of the page.
